{{Quote|The commander was right&mdash;this was a ''trap''. Were those pirates part of it?''"<br />"''They ''exceeded'' the terms of our ''agreement'' when they boarded your ship, Rebel! But the ruse was effective. ''Trusting'' me was your ''downfall'', and now you'll live to ''regret'' it. When I return with you as my ''prisoner'', I'll be made a captain, and my ''name'' will be ''revered'' within the ''Empire''!|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Silam Dunerz]]|<ref name="Leia's Trust" />}}
Sometime during the [[Yavin blockade]], a '''skirmish''' took place aboard the [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']] when [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Silam Dunerz]] laid a trap to capture [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] on her way back from [[Morton (planet)|Morton]].
